title: You Know Me!
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops to wonder — and tonight she looks at her own wiggling fingers and marvels, which is exactly what the psalmist did when he sang that he was wonderfully made.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she loves to wonder at how amazing she’s made. In Wren’s world today: Wren looked at her own hand and wondered, “How did Heavenly Father make my fingers wiggle and my heart go thump?” She felt so special knowing He made every part of her on purpose. Just like the song-writer who marveled that he was wonderfully made, Wren discovered that Heavenly Father made her just right.
